Why Fight Brands Buy From Sialkot

Sialkot is the historic home of combat-sports manufacturing — the same cluster that produces roughly 70% of the world's hand-stitched footballs has been cutting, stitching and decorating fight gear for generations. The skills fightwear needs — stretch-fabric construction, heavy embroidery, sublimation that survives washing and grappling — are native here.

For a gym or fight brand that means: small runs that factories elsewhere refuse (20-set kits vs 500-piece minimums), decoration depth (appliqué ring robes, 3D puff walkout hoodies), and honest pricing because you are buying from the source city. Test us the smart way: a 20-piece trial before any bulk order.

Fightwear Questions

What fightwear can FABRIOZA manufacture?

Fight apparel: sublimated MMA/grappling shorts, compression rash guards (short and long sleeve), boxing ring shorts and robes, walkout tees and hoodies, team tracksuits and gym apparel — with all-over sublimation, embroidery and appliqué in-house. For equipment such as gloves and pads, ask with your enquiry.

What is the minimum order for custom fightwear?

Sublimated fightwear kits start at 15–20 sets; single apparel styles at 50 pieces. A 20-piece trial order is available so gyms and fight brands can test quality first, with the trial cost credited toward bulk.

Why is Sialkot known for combat sports gear?

Sialkot has supplied the world's combat-sports and boxing industry for decades and produces roughly 70% of the world's hand-stitched footballs — a century-old sports-goods cluster whose short-run, decoration-heavy culture is exactly what fightwear production needs.

What fabrics are used for MMA shorts and rash guards?

MMA shorts: 4-way stretch polyester-spandex (typically 160–220 GSM) with sublimated graphics that never crack or peel. Rash guards: compression polyester-spandex 180–230 GSM with flatlock seams. Both are fully customizable in cut, panels and print.

How fast can a fight team get custom kit?

Free design mockup in 24–48 hours, sample in 5–7 business days, production typically 2–3 weeks for sublimated fightwear, plus 3–7 days DDP express delivery to the USA, UK, EU, Australia or the Gulf.
